body.x: Easy Counter System Co. Ltd. introduced ‘Eco-counter’ by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

Easy Counter System Co. Ltd. produce and sell stand-alone automatic calculating machines through technical tie-up with a French company called Eco-counter Co. Ltd., Products of Easy Counter System Co. Ltd. Can figure out pro-environmental circulating population without external power network and internet connection, it only needs battery and mobile communications network Its main clients are 22 National Parks in Korea and Korea Forest Service, Local governments etc.

The representative of Easy Counter System Co. Ltd., Han-eol Cho said that “Eco-counter can be used for various purposes” and that “through scientific analysis, it can contribute with establishing urban-planning as well.” Moreover, he mentioned that he will put efforts to localize software technologies to make this product available in many places.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
